ProgramUnit.Name: GET_BOOKMARKS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*
** this function takes one parameter p_what and returns the 
** result in varchar format.
** p_what = 'COUNT' which returns total bookmarks in the document;
** p_what = number this is a number in varchar format. this passed
** number is used as index and that bookmark name is 
** returned. Unknown indexes get 'ERROR' returned.
*/

function get_bookmarks (p_what varchar2) return varchar2 IS

 ole_id ole2.obj_type;
 ole_args ole2.list_type;
 nTotalBookMarks number;
 szResult varchar2(32);

BEGIN
 ole_id := ole2.create_obj('word.basic');
 ole2.invoke(ole_id, 'AppShow');
--10g forms_ole.exec_verb('valid_letters.letter_text', 1);

 nTotalBookmarks := ole2.invoke_num(ole_id, 'CountBookMarks');

 if p_what = 'COUNT' then
 szResult := to_char(nTotalBookMarks);
 elsif to_number(p_what) < 1 or 
 to_number(p_what) > nTotalBookMarks then
 szResult := 'ERROR';
 else
 ole_args := ole2.create_arglist;
 ole2.add_arg(ole_args, to_number(p_what));
 szResult := ole2.invoke_char(ole_id, 'BookMarkName', ole_args);
 ole2.destroy_arglist(ole_args);
 end if;
 ole2.release_obj(ole_id);
 redisplay;
 synchronize;
 return szResult;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GENERATE_MERGE_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE generate_merge_data IS
 id_rg RecordGroup;
 id_gc GroupColumn;
 curr_group_row number;
 h_tmp_donor_id varchar2(10);
 h_position number;
 next_pos number;
 h_chars number; 
 h_list varchar2(2000);

BEGIN
 id_rg := find_group('DONORS_LIST');
 if not id_null(id_rg) then
 delete_group(id_rg);
 end if;
 id_rg := create_group('DONORS_LIST');
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_rg, 'DonorID', CHAR_COLUMN, 10);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_rg, 'CurrentDate', CHAR_COLUMN, 25);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_rg, 'DonorFullName', CHAR_COLUMN, 100);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_rg, 'DonorLastName', CHAR_COLUMN, 50);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_rg, 'DonorSSN', CHAR_COLUMN, 11);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_rg, 'Address1', CHAR_COLUMN, 100);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_rg, 'Address2', CHAR_COLUMN, 100);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_rg, 'FirstDonYY', CHAR_COLUMN, 25);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_rg, 'Salutation', CHAR_COLUMN, 5);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_rg, 'HisHer', CHAR_COLUMN, 3);
 id_gc := add_group_column(id_rg, 'DonationHistory', CHAR_COLUMN, 2000);
 h_position := 1;
 h_list := :parameter.p_donor_id;
 --pitss synchronize;
 loop
 add_group_row(id_rg, END_OF_GROUP);
 curr_group_row := get_group_row_count(id_rg);

 h_list := ltrim(h_list, '#');
 h_chars := instr(h_list, '#', 1);

 h_tmp_donor_id := substr(h_list, h_position, h_chars - 1);
 h_list := ltrim(h_list, h_tmp_donor_id);

 set_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.DonorID', curr_group_row, h_tmp_donor_id);
-- message ('Extracting....' || h_tmp_donor_id, no_acknowledge);
-- synchronize;

 -- at the end we have '##' pattern
 if substr(h_list, 1, 2) = '##' then 
 exit;
 end if;
 end loop;
 curr_group_row := get_group_row_count(id_rg);
 populate_donor_information(id_rg);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_DONOR_INFORMATION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*********
 Modified and Verified for Y2k .......YPG......06/11
*********/

/*
** this is the procedure where we populate the records group
** for the donors
*/

PROCEDURE Populate_donor_information(id_rg recordgroup) IS
 curr_group_row number;
 nTotalRows number;
 h_tmp_donor_id varchar2(10);
 szDonorFirstName varchar2(100);
 szDonorMiddleName varchar2(100);
 szDonorLastName varchar2(100);
 szDonorLastNameSuffix varchar2(100);
 szAddress1 varchar2(100);
 szAddress2 varchar2(100);
 szSalutation varchar2(5);
 szGender varchar2(5);
 szHisHer varchar2(3);
 szLastName varchar2(50);
 nDonorSSN number;
 szDonorStreetName varchar2(50);
 szDonorSuiteApt varchar2(50);
 szTmpVar varchar2(100);
 szTmpVar1 varchar2(100);
 szFirstDonYY date;
 szDonHist varchar2(20000);

 h_coll_date date;
 h_unit_id varchar2(15);
 h_proc_code varchar2(50);
 
 v_sysdate date;

 cursor don_cur (p_donor_id varchar2) is
 select donors.first_name,
 substr( donors.middle_name, 1, 1 ),
 donors.last_name,
 donors.last_name_suffix,
 donors.salutation,
 decode(donors.gender, 'M', 'Mr.', 'F', 'Ms.'),
 decode(donors.gender, 'M', 'His', 'F', 'Her', 'Hir'),
 donors.ssn,
 donor_addresses.street_name,
 donor_addresses.suite_apt,
 valid_city_state.city || ', ' || upper(valid_city_state.state) ||' ' || valid_city_state.zip
 from donors, donor_addresses, valid_city_state
 where donors.donor_id = p_donor_id
 and donor_addresses.donor_id = donors.donor_id
 and valid_city_state.usps_id = donor_addresses.usps_id;

 cursor min_don_cur (p_donor_id varchar2) is
 select min(coll_date)
 from donations
 where donor_id = p_donor_id;

 cursor cur_donhist (p_donor_id varchar2) is
 select donations.coll_date, donations.unit_id, vpc.description
 from donations, valid_proc_codes vpc
 where donations.donor_id = p_donor_id
 and donations.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and vpc.procedure_code = donations.procedure_code
 and donations.unit_id is not null
 order by donations.coll_date desc;

BEGIN
 -- Added by Kishore on 09/25/2013. IM 9652
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 v_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 else
 v_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if;
 -- End of change

 if id_null(id_rg) then
 message('Err.: Record group cannot be found');
 exit_form(no_validate);
 end if;
 nTotalRows := get_group_row_count(id_rg);
 if nTotalRows = 0 then
 message ('Err: No Donors to retrieve information.');
 exit_form(no_validate);
 end if;

 for i in 1 .. nTotalRows
 loop
 h_tmp_donor_id := get_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.DonorId', i);
 open don_cur(h_tmp_donor_id);
 fetch don_cur 
 into szDonorFirstName,
 szDonorMiddleName,
 szDonorLastName,
 szDonorLastNameSuffix,
 szSalutation,
 szGender,
 szHisHer,
 nDonorSSN,
 szDonorStreetName,
 szDonorSuiteApt,
 szAddress2;
 exit when don_cur%notfound;

 open min_don_cur(h_tmp_donor_id);
 fetch min_don_cur 
 into szFirstDonYY;

-- message( 'Sal ' || szSalutation || ' Gen ' || szGender ); pause;
 szTmpVar := '';
 if szSalutation is null then
 szSalutation := szGender;
 end if;
-- nvl( szSalutation, szGender ) || ' ' ||
 if szDonorMiddleName is not null then
 szDonorMiddleName := szDonorMiddleName || '. ';
 end if;
 szTmpVar := szDonorFirstName || ' ' ||
 szDonorMiddleName || 
 szDonorLastName || ' ' || 
 szDonorLastNameSuffix;
 set_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.DonorFullName', i, szTmpVar);
 szTmpVar := '';
 szTmpVar := szDonorStreetName;
 if szdonorSuiteApt is not null then
 szTmpVar := szTmpVar || ', ' || szDonorSuiteApt;
 end if;
 set_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.Address1', i, szTmpVar);
 set_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.Address2', i, szAddress2);
 set_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.Salutation', i, szSalutation);
 set_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.HisHer', i, szHisHer);
 set_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.DonorLastName', i, szDonorLastName);
 set_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.FirstDonYY', i, to_char(szFirstDonYY, 'YYYY'));
 szTmpVar := '';
 szTmpVar := lpad(to_char(nDonorSSN), 9, '0');
 szTmpVar1 := substr(szTmpVar, 1, 3) || '-' ||
 substr(szTmpVar, 4, 2) || '-' ||
 substr(szTmpVar, 6); 
-- message( 'SSN ' || to_char(nDonorSSN) || ' New ' || szTmpVar1 ); pause;
 set_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.DonorSSN', i, szTmpVar1);
 --set_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.CurrentDate', i, to_char(sysdate, 'FMMonth DD, YYYY')); -- Commented by Kishore on 09/25/2013. IM 9652
 set_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.CurrentDate', i, to_char(v_sysdate, 'FMMonth DD, YYYY')); -- Added by Kishore on 09/25/2013. IM 9652
-- to_char(sysdate, 'FMMONTH') || to_char(sysdate, ' FMDD, YYYY'));
-- set_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.CurrentDate', i, to_char(sysdate, 'MONTH DD, YYYY'));
 if min_don_cur%ISOPEN then
 close min_don_cur;
 end if;
 if don_cur%ISOPEN then
 close don_cur;
 end if;

 szTmpVar := null;
 szDonHist := null;
 open cur_donhist(h_tmp_donor_id);
 loop
 fetch cur_donhist
 into h_coll_date, h_unit_id, h_proc_code;
 exit when cur_donhist%notfound;
 /*
 ** As printing has changed from Word to Std, these changes
 ** note also the chr(13) replacement as hard <return>
 ** A limit of 20000 chars is also introduced on History
 ** hence the temp vars and length check
 **
 ** szDonHist := szdonHist || to_char(h_coll_date, 'MM-DD-YY') || chr(9) || chr(9) ||
 h_unit_id || chr(9) || h_proc_code || chr(13);
 */
 szTmpVar := to_char(h_coll_date, 'MM-DD-RR') || ' ' || 
 h_unit_id || substr( ' ', 1, 20 - length( h_unit_id )) || 
 h_proc_code || '
';
 if length( szdonHist || szTmpVar ) > 20000 then
 show_error( '18195' ); --Too many donations exists for this donor, attach report
 szDonHist := 'See attached Report...';
-- szDonHist := szdonHist || 'Attach Report...';
 else
 szDonHist := szdonHist || szTmpVar;
 end if;
 end loop;
 if cur_donhist%isopen then
 close cur_donhist;
 end if;
 if length( szDonHist ) > 1980 then
 set_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.DonationHistory', i, 
 substr( szDonHist, 1, 1980) || '
Attach Report...' );
 else
 set_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.DonationHistory', i, szDonHist);
 end if;
 end loop;
 if cur_donhist%isopen then
 close cur_donhist;
 end if;
 if min_don_cur%ISOPEN then
 close min_don_cur;
 end if;
 if don_cur%ISOPEN then
 close don_cur;
 end if;

 load_data_file(id_rg, szDonHist);
END;

PROCEDURE load_data_file (id_rg recordgroup,
 psDonHist varchar2) IS
 nTotalRows number;
 szDonorFullName varchar2(100);
 szDonorLastName varchar2(100);
 szAddress1 varchar2(100);
 szAddress2 varchar2(100);

 szDonorSSN varchar2(50);

 szHisHer VARCHAR2(3);

 ole_id ole2.obj_type;
 ole_args ole2.list_type;
 nTotalBookMarks number;
 szBookMarkName varchar2(50);

 sContent varchar2(30000);
BEGIN

 /*
 ** check for record group
 */
 if id_null(id_rg) then
 show_error('18027');
 exit_form(no_validate);
 end if;

 nTotalRows := get_group_row_count(id_rg);
 if nTotalRows = 0 then
 show_error('18028');
 exit_form(no_validate);
 end if;


 /*
 ** somwhow here i will have to pull the data file on the 
 ** screen and then load all the information from the record group
 ** and then save it as the merge file name
 */
 szDonHistLong := psDonHist;
 for i in 1 .. nTotalRows
 loop
 sContent := :valid_letters.letter_content;
 szCurrentDate := initcap(get_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.CurrentDate', i));
 sContent := replace( sContent, '&&CurrentDate&&', nvl( szCurrentDate, ' ' ) );

 szSalutation := initcap(get_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.Salutation', i));
 sContent := replace( sContent, '&&Salutation&&', nvl( szSalutation, ' ' ) );

 szDonorFullName := initcap(get_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.DonorFullName', i));
 sContent := replace( sContent, '&&DonorFullName&&', nvl( szDonorFullName, ' ' ) );
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 10/04/2012. IM 9161
 szDonorFullName := initcap(get_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.DonorFullName', i));
 sContent := replace( sContent, '&&Donor Name&&', nvl( szDonorFullName, ' ' ) );
 -- End of change

 szDonorLastName := initcap(get_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.DonorLastName', i));
 sContent := replace( sContent, '&&DonorLastName&&', nvl( szDonorLastName, ' ' ) );

 szDonorSSN := get_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.DonorSSN', i);
 sContent := replace( sContent, '&&DonorSSN&&', nvl( szDonorSSN, ' ' ) );

 szAddress1 := initcap(get_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.Address1', i));
 sContent := replace( sContent, '&&Address1&&', nvl( szAddress1, ' ' ) );

 szAddress2 :=get_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.Address2', i); --initcap(get_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.Address2', i));
 sContent := replace( sContent, '&&Address2&&', nvl( szAddress2, ' ' ) );

 szHisHer := Initcap(get_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.HisHer', i));
 sContent := replace( sContent, '&&HisHer&&', nvl( szHisHer, ' ' ) );

 szFirstDonYY := initcap(get_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.FirstDonYY', i));
 sContent := replace( sContent, '&&FirstdonationYear&&', nvl( szFirstDonYY, ' ' ) );

 szDonHist := get_group_char_cell('DONORS_LIST.DonationHistory', i);
-- sContent := replace( sContent, '&&DonationHistory&&', nvl( szDonHist, ' ' ) );
 if length( szDonHistLong ) > 2000 then
 -- Assumption : Only one Letter is processes at a time....
 sContent := replace( sContent, '&&DonationHistory&&', nvl( szDonHistLong, ' ' ) );
 else
 sContent := replace( sContent, '&&DonationHistory&&', nvl( szDonHist, ' ' ) );
 end if;
/*
 if i < nTotalRows then
 -- if i < total rows then only go to next row.
 ole2.invoke(ole_id, 'NextCell'); -- jump to next column
 end if;
*/
 end loop;
-- message( to_char( length( sContent ))); pause;
 :donor_letter_text.letter_text := ltrim( rtrim( sContent ));
exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
END;

 when no_data_found then

 /*
 ** Generate Parameter List
 */
 begin 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id) ;
 end if ;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 p_status := 'Error creating parameter list '||pl_name;

 -- Added by Kishore on 05/04/2012. IM 8574
 BC_CHECK_REPSERVER.get_reports_server(out_server_name => l_svr_name,

 );

 p_status := 'Err ' || l_err_msg;
 return;
 END IF;

 p_status := 'Error retrieving Server Name';
 return;
 END IF;
 -- End of change
 
 /* Get the report server name from the master code table*/
/* -- Commented on 04/11/2012; Ashok; Below code moved to LTRepServer_Donor.pkg
 BEGIN
 select description 
 into val 
 from valid_master_codes -- Changed from MASTER_CODES. Change made by Kishore on 06/15/2010
 where code_type='OASVR' 
 and code='RPSVR'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1); 
 Exception

 message('Report server is not defined in the SYSPARM table for REPSVR');

 End; 
*/

 ** ADD Parameters to the parameter list
 */
 filename:=p_report_name||'_'||p_donor_id||'_'||LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid||'.pdf';
 report_id:= find_report_object('LTREPORTS');
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_FILENAME,lower(p_report_name)); --'vdrinter.rdf');
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_COMM_MODE,ASYNCHRONOUS);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_EXECUTION_MODE,BATCH);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESTYPE,file);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESNAME,filename);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESFORMAT,'pdf');
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_SERVER,l_svr_name);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_OTHER, 'paramform=no');

 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_CHAPTER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,nvl(p_chapter_id,'WAD'));
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_DONOR_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER, p_donor_id ) ;

 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_LETTER_CODE',TEXT_PARAMETER, p_letter_code ) ;

 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_USER',TEXT_PARAMETER, LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid) ; -- Added by Kishore on 05/31/2011. IM 5758
 
 ReportServerJob:=run_report_object(report_id,pl_id);
 vjob_id := substr(reportserverjob,length(l_svr_name)+2);
 vc_rep_status := REPORT_OBJECT_STATUS(ReportServerJob);
 --message('Status='||vc_rep_status);

 WHILE vc_rep_status in ('RUNNING','OPENING_REPORT','ENQUEUED', null)
 LOOP
 vc_rep_status:=REPORT_OBJECT_STATUS(ReportServerJob);
 END LOOP;

 --message('number -3');

 If vc_rep_status='FINISHED' THEN
 -- Added on 04/11/2011; Ashok; Multiple Report Server feature added. 
 BC_CHECK_REPSERVER.get_reports_url(in_server_name => l_svr_name,
 out_server_url => l_svr_url,

 );
 IF l_err_msg IS NOT NULL THEN

 END IF;
 
 WEB.SHOW_DOCUMENT(l_svr_url || '/reports/rwservlet/getjobid'|| vjob_id ||'?server='||l_svr_name,'_blank');
 
 ------------------------------ 
 --WEB.SHOW_DOCUMENT('/reports/rwservlet/getjobid'|| vjob_id ||'?server='||val,'_blank');
 Else
 message ('Report failed with error message '|| vc_rep_status);
 End if;

-- run_product(REPORTS,rep_dir||p_report_name,ASYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,null);
 p_status := 'OK';
